title: cymbalaria microcalyx var. orphanidiana
intro: Cymbalaria microcalyx var. orphanidiana, commonly known as the European toadflax, is a type of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. The European toadflax has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an antispasmodic and bronchodilator, which helps in relieving coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of the European toadflax include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
